# Copilot Instructions

- Before adding or modifying a deployable workload (Docker Swarm service or Kubernetes Helm Chart), read and satisfy the "New Workload Introduction" checklist in [.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md).
- Enforced cluster-wide controls (e.g., resource limit enforcement) are documented in [charts/CLUSTER_POLICIES.md](../charts/CLUSTER_POLICIES.md) - new Helm charts must comply with these.
